info.name: Cribl As Code API Credentials Datasets API

items.docs: Retrieves a list of all Cribl Lake datasets including their storage configuration, retention policies, and data volume metrics. Available on Cribl Cloud only.
Creates a new Cribl Lake dataset for storing observability data in open formats. Configure storage format, retention period, and access permissions.
